title: Messaging Add to Access List — payload

did.description: The target account's DID whose access list is being modified.

entries.description: The DIDs to add to the account's access list. Entries already present are ignored.

Response.title: Messaging Add to Access List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/access-list/add request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/access-list/add/0.1#response.

did.description: The account whose access list was modified.

added.description: The entries actually added (those not already present in the access list).

accessListCount.description: The resulting number of entries in the account's access list.
